content.title: Sidi Benour Residential Development — 50 Homes
summary: 50 market-rate apartments delivered in an R+13 residential tower in Sidi Benour, Mehelma, as part of a wider 362-home programme.
The project was executed under a complete all-trades package including structural works, facade articulation, building services, and site infrastructure.
description: The R+13 tower combines structural execution, facade articulation, technical building services, and site-wide infrastructure in a single coordinated handover package. Vertical lines and projecting balconies define the facade rhythm.
Completed in 2025, the project included dedicated access roads, utility connections, and comprehensive site grading to fully integrate the building with its surrounding context.
content.authority: A high-rise residential development where structural engineering, facade rhythm, and technical systems are integrated to meet urban housing requirements.

faq.question: What is the Sidi Benour Residential Development?
faq.answer: 50 market-rate apartments in an R+13 residential tower in Sidi Benour, Mehelma, forming part of a wider 362-home programme. Completed in 2025.

faq.question: What construction works were executed on this site?
faq.answer: The project was delivered as a complete all-trades package: reinforced concrete structure, facade works, building services installations, and site roads and utility infrastructure.

faq.question: How does the building integrate with its surroundings?
faq.answer: Dedicated access roads, utility connections, and comprehensive site grading were included in scope, fully integrating the tower with the surrounding site and infrastructure.
